_comment: Exercises options.c txt2key() (6978-7064) and parsebindings() (7611-7660) through BIND lines, one for each txt2key() branch: '^-v' (a caret with the optional hyphen), '006' (three decimal digits), '99z' (a third character that is not a digit), 'M-' (meta of the hyphen itself), 'C-?' (rubout), '<esc>' and '<space>' (the named keys), '\t' (a backslash escape), 'mz' (meta of a plain character, on a line whose comma-separated right half '<enter>:look' is parsed first) and 'nz', which names no key. ^V, ^F, DEL, space and tab, pressed afterwards, each open the inventory; ESC, although bound to it too, does nothing on the map.
